rules: The V23 Top10 candidate set membership is fixed and teammate-verified; it is never regenerated, re-selected, or extended.
Reranking is permitted only inside the original V23 Top7 set.
Positions 8-10 of the Top10 are never reordered by internal rerankers.
At most one external item may be admitted, only at position 10 (boundary_admission).
Novel-slot reranking touches Novel slots only (novel_only_rerank); history items are protected.
transfer_policy: The contract principle (fixed membership, rerank inside a protected subset) is portable; the A2 candidate items themselves are not.
